items.title: These Researchers Made AI Drive a Toyota Corolla to Get In-N-Out
items.summary: Three engineers put GPT, Claude, and Grok in charge of a real car. Only one of them was successful.

items.title: The New ChatGPT Is More Show Than Tell
items.summary: OpenAI is updating ChatGPT for all users with an “Intelligent UI” that’s more visual—generating interactive elements as part of the chatbot’s outputs.

items.title: The Pentagon Hopes to Speed Up ‘Kill Chain’ AI Buys With 5-Minute Videos
items.summary: The US government’s Tradewinds initiative has made it easier to throw millions of dollars at “nontraditional” defense contractors, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
items.author: Maddy Varner

items.title: OpenAI Wants Its New Agent to Run Your Life. Mine Said It Loved Me
items.summary: Dots are designed to automate online tasks, like buying furniture. In my initial experience, the always-on agent was a bit buggy and couldn’t complete a captcha.

items.title: Your Next Great Read Might Be Certified ‘Organic’
items.summary: Amid a sea of AI writing slop, a new stamp for “organic literature” will help readers to pick out books authored by real, corn-fed, free-range humans.
items.author: Joel Khalili
